hero.title: Context & Harness Engineering
hero.subtitle: Your developers already use a coding agent such as Claude Code. Move from ad-hoc use to a team-wide agentic layer, and learn to delegate while staying in control of the outcome.

features.title: Controlled context
features.description: What the agent knows is chosen, not endured: context window, pitfalls to avoid, management commands.

features.title: Shared building blocks
features.description: Skills, subagents and plugins distributed across every repository of the team.

features.title: Automated checks
features.description: Measurable success criteria and verification loops that tell the agent whether it succeeded.

features.title: Delegate without losing control
features.description: Permissions, sandbox and scoping: the agent moves forward, you stay in charge of the result.

chapters.title: Context
topics: Overview and demystification: agent, subagent, orchestration, harness
The context window: anatomy, limits, pitfalls (poisoning, confusion, clash, distraction), management commands
Introduction to the building blocks: hooks, skills, subagents, plugins

chapters.title: Building blocks
topics: Hooks, skills, commands, subagents: anatomy, triggering, best practices
Plugin: a single source distributed to every repository
Workflows: Research → Plan → Implement, measurable success criteria, verification loops

chapters.title: Practice
chapters.tagline: The team works on its own needs, with guidance.
topics: Parallelization: worktrees, subagents in fan-out and pipeline
Scoping: one need, one outcome, one exit criterion per group

steps.title: Short theory
steps.description: Just enough to set the key concepts.

steps.title: Workshops in pairs or mob
steps.description: On the team's own repositories, not a toy project.

steps.title: Practice between sessions
steps.description: The team applies it to real work before the next session.
